content_sections.heading: DTU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. DTU/CSE/2026/641/05-B gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DTU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Completed/Pursuing M.E./ M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering / Information Technology / Software Engineering / Cyber Security / Artificial Intelligence / Electronics & Communications / Mathematics & Computing or a closely related discipline with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.; OR Completed/Pursuing B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering / Information Technology / Software Engineering / Cyber Security / Artificial Intelligence / Electronics & Communications / Mathematics & Computing or a closely related discipline with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.; OR Completed or Pursuing MCA with minimum 70% marks or equivalent CGPA. Age limit: Maximum 25 years Age relaxation: Age relaxation, if any, shall be applicable as per Government of India / DTU / funding agency norms. Other conditions: The selected candidate shall be required to maintain strict confidentiality of project data and may be required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA). Desirable: Basic knowledge of Python, Full Stack Web Development, AI/ML concepts and implementation, data handling, and documentation, with interest in cybersecurity and applied AI research.

content_sections.heading: DTU Student/Project Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Student/Project Intern will perform the following duties under the supervision of project investigators and project staff: Assist in data preprocessing and annotation. Model implementation, model evaluation and testing. Documentation, dataset preparation, and research support activities.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The position is for 12 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. Engagement is purely contractual, project-based, and renewable subject to satisfactory performance and availability of project funds. A three (03) months satisfactory assessment period shall be mandatory for continuation of engagement.

content_sections.heading: How Will DTU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications based on eligibility and relevant experience Interview of the shortlisted candidates by the Selection Committee Shortlisting followed by an interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form Detailed CV Recent passport size photograph Proofs of educational qualifications Experience certificates Research publications No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently employed

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates appearing for interviews or selection-related processes. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of candidature.
